rentTaxCredit.title: Monthly Rent Tax Credit Calculator
rentTaxCredit.subtitle: Tax year {year} · Check eligibility, see the tax you get back, and claim missed rent from the past five years
rentTaxCredit.salaryHint: Annual pay excluding non-taxable allowances such as meal allowance — the total salary on your withholding receipt.
rentTaxCredit.rentHint: Rent stated in the lease only, without maintenance fees.
rentTaxCredit.monthsHint: Rent paid this year: {amount} KRW. By law, contract rent is prorated per day for the days you actually lived there in the year.

check.title: 1. Check eligibility first
check.desc: Judged as of December 31, {year}. A single "No" means no credit.

house.q: On December 31, does no one in your household own a home?
house.hint: A spouse counts as the same household even with a separate address. A home owned by parents or siblings living with you also disqualifies you.
house.fail: If anyone in the household owns a home on December 31, you cannot claim the credit (Restriction of Special Taxation Act §95-2(1), Enforcement Decree §95(1)). Buying a home during the year removes that whole year's rent.

head.q: Are you the head of household, or does the head not claim housing deductions?
head.hint: Household members can claim if the head does not claim rent, housing subscription savings, jeonse loan repayment or mortgage interest deductions.
head.fail: A household member cannot claim if the head claims any of: rent credit, housing subscription savings, jeonse loan principal and interest, or long-term mortgage interest (RSTA §95-2(1)). The head can claim both the subscription deduction and the rent credit.

home.q: Is the home 85㎡ or less in exclusive area, or worth 400M KRW or less (standard price)?
home.hint: Either one is enough. Residential officetels and gosiwon count, dormitories do not. Non-urban towns outside the capital area allow 100㎡, and from {year} households with three or more dependent children or grandchildren allow 100㎡. Multi-household houses use the area per unit.
home.fail: If both area and standard price exceed the limits, the home does not qualify (Enforcement Decree §95(2)). You can still report the rent for cash receipts and take the card income deduction instead.

address.q: Is your resident registration at the lease address?
address.hint: The lease address must match your resident registration. A fixed-date stamp is not required.
address.fail: If the lease address differs from your registered address, you cannot claim (Enforcement Decree §95(2)3). The NTS also treats a missing move-in report as ineligible.

contract.q: Is the tenant on the lease you or a dependent you claim?
contract.hint: A lease in your spouse's name works if the spouse is your basic dependent (income of 1M KRW or less, or salary of 5M KRW or less if wages only).
contract.fail: If the lease is not in your name or a basic dependent's name, you cannot claim (Enforcement Decree §95(2)4). This includes a spouse with too much income to be your dependent.

salary.q: Is your total salary 80M KRW or less? (checked from your input)
salary.hint: Based on your own salary, not combined with your spouse. With other income, total comprehensive income must also be 70M KRW or less.
salary.fail: Total salary {salary} KRW exceeds 80M KRW, so you are not eligible (RSTA §95-2(1)). The rent cash-receipt income deduction has no income limit.

result.title: 2. What you get back
result.label: Tax actually reduced by rent in {year}
result.notEligible: A "No" in the checklist or salary above the limit means no credit. See the cash-receipt income deduction below.
result.noRent: Enter rent and months to calculate.
result.full: You get the full {max} KRW back (incl. local income tax).
result.capped: Your tax was only {tax} KRW, so only {saving} KRW of the {max} KRW credit counts. The credit never pays out more than the tax you owe.
result.baseCapped: Only 10M KRW of the {paid} KRW paid counts
result.caption: Rent tax credit breakdown
result.tax: Tax before the rent credit (incl. local tax)
result.cash: If taken as cash-receipt deduction instead (max)
result.cashNote: You cannot take both the tax credit and the cash-receipt deduction on the same rent. The cash-receipt figure assumes your card spending already passed 25% of salary, so the tax credit usually wins when you qualify.
result.cashBetter: Here the cash-receipt income deduction is better or the only option. Report your rent on Hometax (housing rent report) to get cash receipts.
result.standard: Claiming the rent credit gives up the 130,000 KRW standard tax credit (Income Tax Act §59-4(9)). The amount already reflects that.
result.assumption: Calculated for one person with no other deductions such as cards. With many other deductions your tax is lower, and so is the real reduction. Check the full refund in the year-end tax calculator.
result.toYearEnd: See full refund in the year-end tax calculator

share.label: Salary {salaryM}M KRW · rent {rentM}M KRW a month
share.headline: Get {amountFull} KRW back
share.sub: {year} rent tax credit (incl. local income tax)
share.text: With a {salaryM}M KRW salary and {rentM}M KRW monthly rent, the rent tax credit gives back {amount} KRW.

past.title: 3. Claim missed rent from the past five years
past.desc: Years you can still claim as of {today}. If you only did year-end settlement, you can file within five years after March 10 of the following year (the settlement tax due date; Framework Act on National Taxes §45-2(5)).

route.yearEnd: Claim now in your company's year-end settlement
route.may: Also possible in the May income tax return

past.rule: Rate {rate}% · rent limit {limitM}M KRW that year
past.totalNote: Upper bound = that year's rate × rent within the limit (at {rent} KRW a month) × 1.1 for local tax. The real refund cannot exceed that year's determined tax, so check the determined tax on that year's withholding receipt. You must also have met the conditions (no home, registered address, etc.) that year.
past.unverified: Tax years {years} are left out because their rules could not be verified.
past.deadlineNote: Deadlines on a Saturday or Sunday move to the next Monday (Framework Act §5). Deadlines can differ if your employer pays tax semiannually or you left mid-year, and for a year you filed your own May return the five years start after the May deadline.

rules.caption: Rent tax credit rules by tax year
notes: Tax year 2022: the higher rates (17%/15%) from the December 31, 2022 amendment also applied to rent paid in 2022 under Addendum Article 18.
From tax year 2023 the home standard-price limit rose from 300M to 400M KRW (Enforcement Decree amended February 28, 2023, from the 2023 tax year).
From tax year 2024 the salary limit rose from 70M to 80M KRW (comprehensive income 60M to 70M) and the rent limit from 7.5M to 10M KRW (amended December 31, 2023, for rent paid from 2024).

The higher rate needs salary of 55M KRW or less and comprehensive income of 45M KRW or less. The area rule (national housing size) and inclusion of officetels and gosiwon are the same in every year shown.

From tax year 2026: households with three or more dependent children or grandchildren may rent up to 100㎡, and a spouse registered in a different city, county or district can claim too (combined couple limit 10M KRW).

docs.title: Documents, and why rent is missing from the simplified service
items: The year-end simplified service only shows rent for public rental housing and rent paid with Hyundai, Shinhan, Samsung or KB cards. Rent sent by bank transfer to a private landlord does not appear, so you submit documents yourself.
Give your employer a resident registration copy, a copy of the lease, and proof of payment (transfer receipts, deposit slips, bank statements). List the rent on your deduction declaration form.
No fixed-date stamp or landlord consent is needed. The fixed date stopped being a requirement from tax year 2014, and landlord consent is not a legal requirement.
If the lease expired but renewed automatically and you still live there, the old lease plus transfer records are enough.
The 80M KRW salary limit is judged on the claimant's own salary, not the couple's.

claim.title: Missed it at year-end settlement: May return or claim for correction
items: In May after the settlement you can add the rent in the comprehensive income tax return: Hometax [Tax returns] → [Comprehensive income tax] → [Wage income return], then choose the regular return.

After that, use [Claim for correction] in the same menu. Your employer's payment statement is prefilled; add the rent and the refund is calculated. The previous year cannot be corrected during the May filing period; the NTS call center said the 2025 tax-year correction service opens around July 2026.
The deadline is five years after the settlement tax due date (March 10 of the next year; Framework Act §45-2(5)). For example, tax year 2021 can be claimed until March 10, 2027.
The tax office must notify you of the result within two months of receiving the claim (Framework Act §45-2(3)).
The documents are the same as at year-end settlement. If you moved that year, prepare the lease and transfer records for every home.

cash.title: How it differs from the rent cash-receipt deduction
items: Rent processed as cash receipts gets the 30% card income deduction like a debit card. It only applies to spending above 25% of salary and has a basic limit (3M KRW at salary of 70M or less, 2.5M above).
You cannot take both the tax credit and the cash-receipt deduction on the same rent. Rent used for the tax credit must be removed from card spending.

With 50M KRW salary and 600,000 KRW rent (7.2M a year), the tax credit is 1,346,400 KRW, while cash receipts give at most 356,400 KRW even if your cards already passed the threshold. If you qualify, the tax credit is far better.

If you fail the credit conditions (salary over 80M, home too large, a household member whose head takes housing deductions), cash receipts are the alternative. One Hometax housing rent report issues receipts automatically on each rent date for the lease period, and you can report within five years of payment.

youth.title: Can you combine it with the youth rent subsidy?
items: The government youth rent subsidy (up to 200,000 KRW a month for up to 24 months) lists only local-government rent programs as non-combinable; the rent tax credit is not on that list (Gov24). The tax law also has no rule excluding subsidy recipients.
However, the law does not say whether the subsidized amount must be subtracted from eligible rent. If the subsidy is large, check with the NTS call center (126) first.
Check youth rent subsidy eligibility (ages 19–34, deposit up to 50M and rent up to 600,000 KRW, etc.) in the youth rent subsidy calculator.

changes.title: What changed in 2026 and proposals before the National Assembly
items: From rent paid in 2026, if the head of household and spouse are registered in different cities, counties or districts (e.g. weekend couples), the spouse can also claim when meeting the conditions. The couple's combined limit is 10M KRW (RSTA §95-2(2), Enforcement Decree §95(5)). Family living at the spouse's address must also own no home.
Households with three or more dependent children or grandchildren may rent homes up to 100㎡ in exclusive area (Enforcement Decree §95(2)1(a), amended February 27, 2026).

The government's August 2026 tax reform proposal raises the rent limit to 12M KRW and applies 17% to young people aged 15–34 regardless of income. It is still before the National Assembly, so this calculator does not include it.
